result.text: Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

result.rule: When the description states that an activity's result or a condition determines which of multiple alternative paths follows: Connect the activity to an exclusive gateway and model each alternative as a separate outgoing branch.
When the description states that an action has mutually exclusive alternatives for how or where it is carried out: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway and a separate task for each alternative.

When the description says that one or more of several optional actions may be selected, including that multiple actions may be performed together: Model the alternatives with an inclusive gateway so any nonempty combination of the actions can proceed.

When the description states that a process can end in one of multiple mutually exclusive outcomes: Model an exclusive gateway with a separate branch for each outcome, leading to the corresponding modeled outcome.
